name: カスタムビューの目的と作成入口を示す空状態
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Linear empty-state content as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the reference crop exactly: a clean white canvas, 450 by 420 pixels, with content inset about 14 pixels from the left and right. Do not add a card frame, outer shadow, app sidebar, page header, or surrounding workspace. Preserve the source vertical placement, text hierarchy, line spacing and two-button row.

At the upper left, draw the same delicate monochrome outline illustration of three offset stacked view cards, with the same approximate 80 by 100 pixel footprint. Below it, use the compact bold heading 「ビュー」. Keep the original generous space between the illustration and heading. Use a clean Japanese sans-serif similar to Linear UI, charcoal text, body text around 15 to 16 pixels and the title around 18 pixels.

Place this four-line explanatory paragraph below the title, retaining the source line rhythm:
「フィルターを使ってカスタムビューを作成し、」
「表示する課題を絞り込めます。ビューは保存・」
「共有・お気に入り登録ができ、チームで素早く」
「アクセスして共同作業できます。」

After the same short vertical gap, place a two-line shortcut paragraph. Translate it as 「既存のビューも、」 followed by the same tiny monochrome stacked-view save icon seen in the reference, then 「アイコンをクリックするか」 on the first line; on the second line write 「⌥ V を押して保存できます。」. Render ⌥ and V as two small separate outlined rounded keyboard keycaps, as in the source. Keep the inline icon and keycaps aligned with the text baseline.

At the bottom, align two compact pill-shaped buttons on one row with the source spacing and sizes. The left button is filled soft Linear periwinkle-blue with white text 「新しいビューを作成」. The right button is white with a thin pale-gray outline and dark text 「ドキュメント」. Keep each button about 36 pixels tall with fully rounded ends. Preserve the small gap between them and the left-aligned row position.

Maintain the same restrained empty-state style: precise thin gray line art, subtle neutral text, generous whitespace, no extra decoration, no English text, no additional controls, and no invented copy. Preserve the 450 by 420 composition and keep every element within the crop.
reviewNotes: Faithful Japanese Linear saved-view empty state with stacked icon, heading, four-line explanation, two-line save shortcut, and paired actions. Candidate 1298x1212 (1.0710:1) matches 450x420 (1.0714:1) within 0.1%; source/candidate visual comparison confirms close placement and hierarchy.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
